description: This Java interface defines configuration settings related to persistence operations in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies a method to retrieve a delay duration after persistence actor shutdown and an internal enum listing known configuration values with default settings.

classes.name: PersistenceOperationsConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration methods and an enum for persistence operation settings.

classes.name: PersistenceOperationsConfigValue
classes.description: An enum that lists known configuration settings with their default values and paths.

methods.name: getDelayAfterPersistenceActorShutdown
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait after a persistence actor has been shut down before starting purging.
